messages:
maya: quick FYI 10: after the IdP cert rotation window last night a subset of EU SSO logins immediately dropped and several SCIM role changes didn't appear in the audit index. anyone oncall saw alerts?

sam: saw failed session validations in the SP logs. assertion verified ok but server-side session blob decrypt timed out and we clear the cookie. reproduced with a simulated KMS delay.

jen: SCIM path shows 200s from our server, but there's no corresponding role-change event in the audit stream. looks like we ack the idp request despite downstream write failure.

aaron: infra ran a KMS rekey at 02:11 UTC. control plane reported success but KMS p95 jumped to ~3.2s for ~3min. that aligns with the window.

maya: so likely race between rekey and live decrypts -> timeouts -> we swallow failures. that's a dangerous pattern for RBAC changes and compliance logging.

sam: logs show: "Session validate: KMS decrypt DEADLINE_EXCEEDED" then "Cleared session ...". suggestion: instrument sp_kms_decrypt_timeouts and scim_role_write_kms_timeouts metrics so we can alert next time before user-visible loss.

jen: immediate mitigation: change SCIM ack behavior so we don't silently accept on decrypt failure. return 409 on decrypt timeout once (idp will retry) rather than ack. also add an audit preflight entry "role-write-attempt" before mapping so the attempted change is traceable.

aaron: short-term I can add a cached-decrypt fallback (TTL 12-24h) so brief rotation windows don't cause total failure. I'll also work with infra to shift rekeys to low-traffic windows and add jitter to avoid synchronized storms.

maya: good. longer-term: vuln triage flagged swallowing KMS errors as a silent-data-loss anti-pattern. postmortem should recommend a platform-level library pattern: explicit small retries | cache fallback | surface to caller (non-200) after retry short-circuit.

sam: I'll own reproducible test + canary plan. jen: you own the audit preflight + metric. aaron: you own cache fallback & coordination with infra. maya: you'll draft the postmortem and oncall notify text.

oncall-bot: incident opened INC-2026-031-07: "KMS rekey overlap -> decrypt timeouts causing SSO session invalidation and SCIM role write loss". paging oncall.

jen: also add a compliance ticket to ensure all role changes have an immutable audit record (preflight + final) even if downstream write ultimately fails. auditors will want an attempt-level trail.

maya: agreed. we'll include that in remediation. closing loop in the incident doc and prioritizing fixes. :thumbsup:
